correctness.rationale: Exact open-path pair-connectivity counting yields the risk polynomial. Strict AM-GM forces symmetric outer treatment for each fixed center effort; the one-dimensional reduced objective has strictly positive second derivative, with derivative signs giving an iff boundary. The monotone cubic gives a unique interior allocation and its boundaries. Three-vertex calculation certifies the minimal path comparison. Independent exact-rational 8-state enumeration, an explicit 57/32 versus 8177/4608 witness and numeric sampled checks supplement the proof, not substitute for it.

value.rationale: The study answers a natural spatial firebreak budget question as a complete all-budget phase classification: a finite support transition, exact log(1+p) critical cost, cubic allocation, central-link priority and asymptotic equalization. It is motivated by empirical fuel-break width versus density tradeoffs. This is not a mere model renaming or one numeric comparison; it gives a sharp structural explanation of when to spread limited protection among edges.
